msg: Olá! Somos dois brasileiros, nunca mergulhamos. Quanto custa o batismo e o que está incluído?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. So happy to have you here! I'd love to help you put your plan together. 🌊

Hi! A first dive in the Rosario Islands is a wonderful way to discover the underwater world together 🐠

For beginners, our *Dive Mini Course* costs *USD 183 per person* when booked online. It includes the boat trip from Cartagena to the islands and back, lunch, and diving gear. You’ll have pool practice and one ocean dive with an instructor; no previous certification is needed. It’s a one-day experience and does not certify you to dive.

You can choose your date and number of people here: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/minicurso-de-buceo/2?language=en
